name: split-grouped-candidate
rationale: CANDIDATE FOR REVIEW: split docs describe str.split analogy and grouping separators with sep=None. Map each literal space to None, split once, then map the output back. This probes whether a consecutive separator run remains grouped at maxsplit=1, rather than treating every remaining separator as content. A mismatch is a documentation/behavior discrepancy requiring review, not automatically a confirmed defect.
domain: Strings from a, b, and literal space, length 0 through 40. maxsplit is fixed at positive 1; maxsplit=0 is deliberately excluded because upstream tests specify unchanged output.
